instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "When the person's posts change, set each post that is set to go at its time to be sent then, to each of its destinations, by that place's send row", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:send-each-post-at-its-time and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Runs on its own once the person switches on its wake (at-its-time): each time their posts change, it reads the changed posts, and for each one set to go at its time (tool:set-a-post-to-go-at-its-time) it sets one run of tool:send-a-post (told the destination's place) per destination still to be sent, at the post's scheduled_for.
4. It only reads only its own rows through the records door: post (records:read); connection (records:read).
5. It reaches only these places in the person's files: / (share_file, read_file).
